protocol.linear_attention: native Gated DeltaNet unchanged; excluded from P/K/V/KV cache comparison

datasets.partition: SHA256(row text) low bit: calibration=0 evaluation=1

protocol.samples: One nonoverlapping packed text stream per domain and partition, exact T+8 token prefix. No cycling if insufficient text. Store source row IDs and token SHA256, do not commit dataset text or weights.
protocol.policy_selection: Per-layer minimum arithmetic mean attention-output relative L2 error across all calibration contexts, steps and domains; tie order P,K,V,KV. Freeze before evaluation.

timing.scope: decode attention replay with preallocated workspace and GPU q/output FWHT; untimed cache construction; matched FP16 paged split baseline

protocol.phase_A_scope: Real-model teacher-forced decode layer replay; not total-model latency, online KV append, serving capacity or serving E2E. Per-layer FP16 fallback numerical tolerance 0.002; INT4-versus-FP16 quality is observational, not this tolerance.
protocol.phase_B: Actual layer-policy model decode quality and model-total decode latency require online packed-cache append integration; E09 overall remains incomplete until this is implemented and measured.
protocol.code_text_format: MBPP task text + official test_setup_code + reference code + test_list + challenge_test_list. Same format for calibration/evaluation; no sample cycling.
protocol.revision_reason: v1 full run stopped before any matrix measurements because MBPP train text+code only provided 28,993 tokens, below 32K. Include official tests; retain v1 failure and completed smoke.
